title: 1995 Suzuki Jimny Turbo 4×4 5-Speed
highlights: This 1995 Suzuki Jimny hardtop was refinished in gray before the selling dealer’s acquisition in 2025 and subsequent importation to the US, and it has been fitted with a tubular front bumper and 16″ five-spoke wheels. Power is provided by a turbocharged 658cc inline-three linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a two-speed transfer case.

title: 1979 MG MGB Roadster
highlights: This 1979 MGB roadster was mostly kept in storage for approximately 40 years by the previous owner, and the seller purchased the car as a project in May 2025 and soon began a refurbishment that was completed in preparation for the sale. Finished in Brooklands Green over beige vinyl, the vehicle is powered by a 1.8-liter inline-four paired with a four-speed manual transmission.

title: 1977 Jaguar XJ6C
highlights: This 1977 Jaguar XJ6C has been refinished in red over Cinnamon Connolly leather upholstery and is powered by a 4.2-liter inline-six mated to a three-speed automatic transmission. It is equipped with 15″ GKN Kent alloy wheels, four-wheel disc brakes, an independent front and rear suspension, front bucket seats, burl walnut trim, rear-cabin heating and ventilation controls, and a cassette stereo.

title: 1974 Triumph TR6
highlights: This 1974 Triumph TR6 was purchased by its current owner after the car was listed on BaT in December 2022, and it is powered by a 2.5-liter inline-six mated to a four-speed manual transmission. Finished in Pimento over black vinyl upholstery, the car is equipped with 15″ steel wheels with polished trim rings along with chrome bumpers, black stripes and graphics, dual carburetors, a wood-veneer dashboard, a heater, and a cassette stereo.

title: 1977 MG MGB Roadster
highlights: This 1977 MGB roadster is powered by a 1.8-liter inline-four paired with a four-speed manual transmission, and it is finished in green over Autumn Leaf vinyl upholstery.

title: 14k-Mile 2005 Jaguar S-Type R 4.2
highlights: This 2005 Jaguar S-Type R has 14k miles following registration history in New York, Florida, and Pennsylvania, and it is powered by a supercharged 4.2-liter V8 linked to a six-speed automatic transmission.

title: 1984 Ferrari Mondial Quattrovalvole Cabriolet
highlights: This 1984 Ferrari Mondial Quattrovalvole cabriolet remained registered in British Columbia through the selling dealer’s acquisition in 2024, and it now shows 16k kilometers (~10k miles). Powered by a 2.9-liter F105A V8 paired with a five-speed manual transaxle, the car is finished in Rosso Corsa over black leather upholstery.

title: 26k-Mile 2004 Jaguar XKR Portfolio Convertible
highlights: This 2004 Jaguar XKR convertible is one of 200 Portfolio examples produced, and it was purchased in 2015 by the seller, who has since added 11k of the 26k miles indicated. Finished in Jupiter Red over Cranberry and Charcoal leather, the car has been modified with Arden-style exterior components, lowering springs, LED lighting, a Bluetooth audio adapter, and an Adamesh exhaust system.

title: 1989 Ferrari 328 GTS
highlights: This 1989 Ferrari 328 is one of approximately 6,068 removable-top GTS examples produced. The car is finished in Rosso Corsa over beige leather upholstery, and it is powered by a fuel-injected 3.2-liter V8 paired with a five-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential.

title: 1989 Lancia Delta HF Integrale 16V
highlights: This 1989 Lancia Delta HF Integrale 16V was reportedly delivered new in Spain and was imported to North America in recent years before being acquired by the selling dealer in 2025. The car is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-four that drives all four wheels through a five-speed manual transaxle, a viscous center differential, and a Torsen limited-slip rear differential.

title: 1982 Ferrari 308 GTSi Project
highlights: This 1982 Ferrari 308 GTSi project was sold new by Ferrari of Los Gatos in California, and it remained registered in the state through the current owner’s acquisition in 2001. The car was repainted in the current shade of yellow around 2005, and it is equipped with a fuel-injected 2.9-liter quad-cam V8 that currently has coolant contamination in the oil.

title: 1984 GMC C7000 Fire Truck 5-Speed
highlights: This 1984 GMC 7000 fire truck is powered by a 7.0-liter V8 paired with a five-speed manual transmission. It served with two fire departments before being purchased by the seller in 2024. Outfitted as a fire truck by Quality Manufacturing Inc. of Talladega, Alabama, the vehicle is finished in red and white and features a Waterous pump system, a 750-gallon water tank, and 20″ steel wheels.

title: 1967 Mercury Park Lane 2-Door Hardtop
highlights: This 1967 Mercury Park Lane is one of 2,196 two-door hardtops produced for the model year. The car is claimed to have had a single owner between the early 1990s and 2026, when it was acquired by the selling dealer. Originally white, it has been repainted metallic turquoise, and a custom sound system and 15″ Ultra alloy wheels have been added.

title: 843cc-Powered 1957 Fiat 600 Multipla
highlights: This 1957 Fiat 600 Multipla is believed to have been refurbished circa 2020. It is finished in red and white and powered by a retrofitted 843cc inline-four mated to a four-speed manual transaxle. The interior features a front bench as well as two rows of fold-down seats, and further equipment includes a retractable sunroof, rear-hinged front doors, and sliding center windows.

title: 2007 Toyota Sequoia Limited
highlights: This 2007 Toyota Sequoia Limited is finished in Phantom Gray Pearl over gray leather and is powered by a 4.7-liter V8 linked with a five-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, a locking center differential, and a limited-slip rear differential.

title: 10k-Mile 2003 BMW Z8 Alpina V8
highlights: This 2003 BMW Alpina Roadster V8 is #128 of 555 examples produced, and it has 10k miles. Powered by an Alpina-tuned 4.8-liter V8 paired with a five-speed Switch-Tronic automatic transmission, the car is finished in Titanium Silver Metallic over black Nappa leather upholstery.

title: 49k-Mile 2000 Mercedes-Benz SL500
highlights: This 2000 Mercedes-Benz SL500 has been registered in California and Texas from new, and 7k of the 49k miles have been added since the current owner purchased the car in May 2024. It is finished in Desert Silver Metallic over beige leather and is powered by a 5.0-liter V8 paired with a five-speed automatic transmission.

title: 2023 Audi S3 Premium Plus
highlights: THIS... is a 2023 Audi S3 Premium Plus, finished in Mythos Black Metallic with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this Audi’s past.

title: 1964 Volkswagen Beetle
highlights: This 1964 Volkswagen Beetle is said to have remained in California with two owners, the second of which carried out a refurbishment in 2013 that included painting the bodywork in green, reupholstering the interior in brown and tan, refinishing the wheels, and installing a custom chrome and wood roof rack.

title: 1994 Mitsubishi Minicab Fire Truck 4-Speed
highlights: This 1994 Mitsubishi Minicab is a right-hand-drive cab-over fire truck powered by a 657cc inline-three mated to a four-speed manual transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a push-button four-wheel-drive system. It is finished in red over two-tone gray upholstery and features a siren, an emergency light, and a bed-mounted seat and storage framework as well as 12″ steel wheels, front disc brakes, and a heater.

title: 2011 Toyota FJ Cruiser
highlights: This 2011 Toyota FJ Cruiser was purchased new by the current owner and now has 117k miles. Finished in Iceberg over Dark Charcoal cloth, it is powered by a 4.0-liter 1GR-FE V6 linked with a five-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a locking rear differential.

title: 2004 Lexus RX330 AWD
highlights: This 2004 Lexus RX330 remained registered in California under the care of its original owner until 2026 and now has 79k miles. Powered by a 3.3-liter V6 linked to a five-speed automatic transaxle and an all-wheel-drive system with a viscous coupling center differential, the truck is finished in Flint Mica over Light Gray leather upholstery.

title: 2003 Jeep Wrangler Sport 4.0 5-Speed
highlights: This 2003 Jeep Wrangler Sport is finished in black over gray cloth, and it remained in the original owner’s care until December 2022. Power is from a 4.0-liter inline-six linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a Command-Trac dual-range transfer case.

title: 6.0-Powered 1988 Land Rover 90
highlights: This 1988 Land Rover is a left-hand-drive 90 that was imported in October 2023. It was retrofitted with a 6.0-liter LQ4 gasoline V8 by Royal Defender Imports of Hutto, Texas. The shop also installed a 4L80E four-speed automatic transmission, and the truck features a locking center differential, 16″ steel wheels, and 33″ tires. Its interior has brown upholstery, contrast stitching, and a Pioneer touchscreen.

title: 1992 Suzuki Carry 4WD 5-Speed Dump Truck w/Scissor Lift
highlights: This 1992 Suzuki Carry is a right-hand-drive pickup that was imported from Japan to the US following the selling dealer’s acquisition in 2026, and it features a hydraulic dump bed with a scissor lift. Power is provided by a 657cc inline-three linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case.

title: 347-Powered 1985 Ford Mustang LX SSP 5-Speed
highlights: This 1985 Ford Mustang LX notchback is a Special Service Package (SSP) example powered by a Roush 347ci V8 crate engine that was fitted in 2003, and it is finished in black over replacement gray cloth upholstery.

title: 34k-Mile 2011 Land Rover Range Rover Supercharged
highlights: This 2011 Land Rover Range Rover Supercharged remained registered with the original owner until 2026 and now has 34k miles. The truck is finished in Stornoway Gray over gray leather upholstery and is powered by a supercharged 5.0-liter AJ133 V8 that drives all four wheels through a six-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case.

title: 2008 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet
highlights: THIS… is a 2008 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet, finished in Arctic Silver Metallic with a black soft top and black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this 911’s past. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Sport Chrono Package, 19-inch wheels, a power-operated soft top, full leather upholstery, and power-adjustable heated front seats.

title: 33k-Mile 2014 Mercedes-Benz E63 S AMG 4MATIC Wagon
highlights: This 2014 Mercedes-Benz E63 S AMG 4MATIC is a black-over-black wagon that has remained registered in California through the seller’s purchase in 2025, and it now has 33k miles.

title: “41 Bat” Custom 1983 Buick Riviera Coupe by Bill Hines
highlights: This steel-bodied coupe was created in the 1980s by the seller’s grandfather, noted customizer Bill “The Leadslinger” Hines of California, using a 1941 Buick roof and decklid grafted onto a 1983 Buick Riviera chassis. Dubbed “41 Bat,” the car features hand-formed bodywork with a chopped profile, rounded fenders, faux lake pipes, and swooping fins that extend past the rear bumper.

title: 44k-Mile 2018 Audi TT RS
highlights: This 2018 Audi TT RS was initially delivered to Audi Wilsonville in Oregon and is powered by a turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-five that drives all four wheels through a seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transaxle. The car is finished in Catalunya Red Metallic over black Fine Nappa leather with Crimson Red accents and stitching.

title: 2002 Mercedes-Benz CLK55 AMG Coupe
highlights: This 2002 Mercedes-Benz CLK55 AMG coupe has 65k miles and was sold on BaT in July 2019 and again on BaT in November 2025 before it was acquired by the selling dealer in 2026. Finished in Brilliant Silver Metallic over Charcoal leather upholstery, the car is powered by a 5.4-liter V8 paired with a five-speed automatic transmission.

title: 2004 Honda S2000
highlights: This 2004 Honda S2000 was specified in Sebring Silver Metallic over red and black leather, and it was purchased by the seller from the original owner in October 2022. The car is powered by a 2.2-liter VTEC inline-four linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential.

title: 2020 Aluma 8218 Race Car Trailer
highlights: This 2020 Aluma 8218 race car trailer features a lightweight all-aluminum construction offering durability, corrosion resistance, and reduced towing weight compared to traditional steel trailers. Designed for transporting performance and track-oriented vehicles, it utilizes a low-profile layout measuring approximately 18 feet in length with an 82-inch-wide deck and is rated with a 7,000-lb GVWR.

title: 1988 Mercedes-Benz 560SL
highlights: This 1988 Mercedes-Benz 560SL remained registered in Texas under the care of two prior owners until 2026, and it shows 51k miles. Finished in Blue Black Metallic over gray leather upholstery, the car is powered by a 5.5-liter V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission.

title: 2016 BMW 340i xDrive Sedan
highlights: THIS… is a 2016 BMW 340i xDrive Sedan, finished in Alpine White with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this 340i’s past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the M Sport, Technology, Cold Weather, and Driver Assistance Plus packages, a sunroof, and Dakota leather upholstery.

title: 2016 GMC Savana G2500 Explorer Conversion Van
highlights: THIS... is a 2016 GMC Savana G2500 Explorer Conversion Van, finished in bronze and silver with a beige interior. The odometer on this Savana currently displays approximately 28,100 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report indicates no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Savana’s past. It also shows Southern ownership since new.

title: Hellcat Redeye–Powered 2020 Chrysler 300S
highlights: This 2020 Chrysler 300S was retrofitted in 2022 with a supercharged 6.2-liter SRT V8, and the seller tells us the engine is from a 2021 Hellcat Redeye model rated at 797 horsepower. The car also features modified bodywork and an interior swap with black Nappa leather and Alcantara. Other details include an eight-speed automatic transmission, Brembo brakes, 20″ wheels, a panoramic sunroof, and an 8.4″ touchscreen.

title: 2004 Mercedes-Benz SL500
highlights: This 2004 Mercedes-Benz SL500 has been registered in Florida from new, and it has 53k miles. The car was specified in Diamond Silver Metallic over Ash leather, and it is equipped with the AMG Sport Package, which added revised exterior styling as well as 18″ Alphard alloy wheels. Power is from a 5.0-liter V8 linked to a seven-speed automatic transmission.

title: 1966 Volkswagen Karmann Ghia Convertible
highlights: This 1966 Volkswagen Karmann Ghia convertible has remained under the care of the same family for over 25 years, having been purchased by the seller’s mother some years prior to the seller’s acquisition in 2001. The car was refurbished between 2015 and 2016 by House of Ghia in Salem, Oregon, and it is finished in silver over black upholstery.

title: 1952 MG TD
highlights: This 1952 MG TD is said to have spent time in California before it was relocated to Ohio in 1965, and it remained registered in the previous owner’s family for 61 years before it was acquired by the seller in 2026. The car was refurbished in black over green leather under previous ownership, and it is powered by a 1,250cc XPAG inline-four paired with a four-speed manual transmission.

title: 2013 Audi A6 3.0T Quattro Premium Plus
highlights: THIS… is a 2013 Audi A6 3.0T Quattro Premium Plus, finished in Oolong Gray Metallic with a Nougat Brown interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this A6’s past.

title: 2012 Porsche 911 Carrera Cabriolet
highlights: This 2012 Porsche 911 Carrera is a white-over-black cabriolet that has been registered in Texas from new, and 70k of the 75k miles have been added since the seller purchased the car in September 2013. Factory options included the Premium Plus, Sport Chrono, and Light Design Packages as well as heated and ventilated power-adjustable front sport seats, Porsche Entry & Drive, Power Steering Plus, and a Bose sound system.

title: 2021 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF Grand Touring
highlights: THIS... is a 2021 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF Grand Touring, finished in Soul Red Crystal Metallic with a black interior. This Mazda features the desirable 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 2,700 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report indicates no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this MX-5’s past. It also shows registration to one owner since new.

title: 23k-Mile 1981 Datsun 280ZX GL Turbo
highlights: This 1981 Datsun 280ZX Turbo was sold new at Hills Datsun in Wiloughby, Ohio, and remained under the care of its original owner until the seller’s purchase in 2022. Showing 23k miles, the car is powered by a turbocharged 2.8-liter inline-six paired with a three-speed automatic transmission and is finished in Thunder Black Metallic over tan leather upholstery.

title: Vortec-Powered 1992 Jeep Wrangler S
highlights: This 1992 Jeep Wrangler was modified in 2016 with the installation of a 5.3-liter Vortec V8 linked with a four-speed 4L60-E automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case. Refinished in tan with a removable brown hardtop, the truck rides on 15″ Cragar steel wheels as well as a suspension lift kit with Bilstein shock absorbers.

title: 2014 Land Rover LR4 HSE Luxury
highlights: This 2014 Land Rover LR4 HSE Luxury has 78k miles and is powered by a supercharged 3.0-liter AJ126 V6 that drives all four wheels through an eight-speed automatic transmission.

title: 2012 Bentley Continental Flying Spur Speed
highlights: This 2012 Bentley Continental Flying Spur Speed is powered by a twin-turbocharged 6.0-liter W12 that drives all four wheels through a six-speed automatic transaxle, and it is finished in Blue Crystal over Linen diamond-quilted leather upholstery.

title: 2,200-Mile 2004 Nissan 350Z Touring Coupe 6-Speed
highlights: This 2004 Nissan 350Z Touring coupe was initially sold in Pennsylvania and spent time in New York before the seller’s acquisition on BaT in August 2025. Finished in Glacier White over Frost leather, the car is powered by a 3.5-liter V6 linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential.

title: 2013 Audi A4 Allroad Quattro Premium
highlights: THIS... is a 2013 Audi A4 Allroad Quattro Premium, finished in Phantom Black Pearl Effect with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this A4 Allroad’s past.

title: Miata-Powered 1967 MG MGB GT 5-Speed
highlights: This 1967 MGB GT was purchased by the seller in 2012, and a subsequent refurbishment involved the installation of a rebuilt and modified Mazda Miata NB–sourced BP4W 1.8-liter inline-four and a corresponding five-speed manual gearbox.

title: 2004 Volvo XC70
highlights: This 2004 Volvo XC70 was initially delivered to Superior Volvo North of Kansas City, Missouri, and it remained under the care of a single registered owner until 2026.

title: 25k-Mile 2004 Lincoln Town Car Signature
highlights: This 2004 Lincoln Town Car Signature was driven 25k miles by its only owner, and its Silver Birch Metallic-finished bodywork has a black landau roof.

title: 2023 Dodge Challenger Scat Pack Swinger
highlights: This 2023 Dodge Challenger is one of 1,000 Scat Pack Swinger examples produced. It is finished in White Knuckle over Black Nappa leather and Alcantara and is powered by a 392ci Hemi V8 linked with an eight-speed automatic transmission.

title: 1999 Cagiva Gran Canyon
highlights: This 1999 Cagiva Gran Canyon is powered by a Ducati-sourced 904cc desmodromic L-twin paired with a six speed transmission and is finished in red with silver accents. The bike rides on wire-spoke wheels with alloy rims and is further equipped with triple disc brakes, a top case, hard-sided panniers, an engine guard, and a stainless-steel exhaust system with dual under-the-seat aluminum mufflers.

title: 2018 Mercedes-AMG GLS 63
highlights: THIS... is a 2018 Mercedes-AMG GLS 63, finished in Selenite Gray Metallic with a beige interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this GLS 63’s past. It also shows mostly Arizona registrations since new.

title: 1999 Toyota Land Cruiser HZJ75
highlights: THIS... is a 1999 Toyota Land Cruiser HZJ75, finished in white with a beige interior. This Land Cruiser is a European-spec, left-hand drive SUV that's titled and located in Virginia. The odometer reads in metric units and indicates approximately 179,200 kilometers or roughly 111,400 miles. A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes automatic-locking front hubs, vinyl upholstery, and dual fuel tanks.

title: 33k-Mile 2013 Mini Cooper John Cooper Works GP
highlights: This 2013 Mini Cooper John Cooper Works GP is one of 500 examples produced for the US market. It has 33k miles and remained in the original owner’s care until earlier this year. The car is finished in Thunder Gray Metallic over Carbon Black cloth and leather and is powered by a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-four paired with a six-speed manual transaxle.

title: 2008 Volkswagen R32
highlights: THIS… is a 2008 Volkswagen R32, finished in Candy White with a Satin Metallic Hawaiin Mint wrap and a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this R32’s past. It also shows that this Volkswagen has been registered in Washington State since new.

title: 1962 Plymouth Savoy 2-Door Sedan Super Stock Max Wedge 3-Speed
highlights: This 1962 Plymouth is one of 56 “Super Stock” Savoy two-door sedans produced for the model year with a low-compression 413ci Max Wedge V8 and a three-speed manual transmission. The car was sold new by Maloney Motor Company of Canton, Ohio, in August 1962, and it was drag-raced for a few years in the 1960s. The Savoy was eventually parked for some 20 years in a garage before being removed from storage in the 1990s and refurbished in Ohio.

title: 2018 Volkswagen GTI S
highlights: THIS… is a 2018 Volkswagen GTI S, finished in Pure White with a Clark Plaid interior. This GTI is equipped with the desirable 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 12,000 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this GTI’s past.

title: 2017 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport Coupe
highlights: THIS... is a 2017 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport Coupe, finished in black with a black interior. This coupe is equipped with the desirable 7-speed manual transmission, and its odometer displays about 19,400 miles. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents or mileage inconsistencies in this C7's past. It also shows that this car has been registered in Texas and Arizona since new.

title: 1970 Dodge Charger 500 383
highlights: This 1970 Dodge Charger 500 is said to have been delivered new to Paoli Bros. Inc. of Eureka, California, and was registered in that state through 2024. Powered by a 383ci V8 linked with a three-speed automatic transmission, the car is finished in Light Gold Metallic over black vinyl.

title: 1957 Chevrolet Suburban Carryall 4-Speed
highlights: This 1957 Chevrolet 3106 Suburban Carryall was acquired by the selling dealer in 2025 and is believed to have spent the majority of its time in Arizona prior to the selling dealer’s purchase. The truck was repainted green and a Champion aluminum radiator and an under-floor brake booster were installed under prior ownership. Power is provided by a 235ci Thriftmaster straight-six linked to a floor-shifted four-speed manual transmission.

title: 20k-Mile 2019 Ford Mustang GT Coupe 6-Speed
highlights: This 2019 Ford Mustang is a Canadian-market GT coupe that was imported to the US in July 2019, and it has been registered in Washington and Oregon ever since. Indicating 20k miles, the car was specified in Orange Fury Metallic Tri-Coat over Ebony cloth, and power is provided by a 5.0-liter V8 linked with a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential.

title: 2018 Ducati Scrambler Cafe Racer
highlights: This 2018 Ducati Scrambler Cafe Racer is powered by an 803cc SOHC L-twin equipped with a desmodromic valvetrain and electronic fuel injection.

title: 1972 AM General M151A2 "MUTT"
highlights: THIS… is a 1972 AM General M151A2, finished in tan with a tan interior. This M151A2 was built for the United States Army and was reportedly purchased by the owner in March 2021. It’s currently street-legal and titled in Texas. A partial list of notable currently installed equipment reported by the seller includes 16-inch steel wheels, 4-wheel independent suspension, a 24-volt electrical system, a folding windscreen, a heater, and a pioneer kit.

title: 385-Mile 2023 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat Widebody Jailbreak
highlights: This 2023 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat Widebody Jailbreak is a Last Call edition example that was purchased new by the seller in California and now has 385 miles. It is finished in Pitch Black over Black and Demonic Red Laguna leather, and power is provided by a supercharged 6.2-liter V8 linked to an eight-speed automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential.

title: 2011 Cadillac Escalade EXT Luxury AWD
highlights: This 2011 Cadillac Escalade EXT Luxury is finished in Black Raven over Ebony leather and is powered by a 6.2-liter Vortec V8 that drives all four wheels through a six-speed automatic transmission and a locking rear differential.

title: 5-Mile 2016 Honda ST1300PA
highlights: This 2016 Honda ST 1300PA was produced for police use and is said to have remained in storage, not fully assembled, at a dealership from initial delivery until shortly before the seller’s purchase in February 2026. Reported work three months later consisted of sourcing and fitting missing fairing panels, changing the fluids, and replacing the battery.

title: 1986 Buick Regal T-Type
highlights: This 1986 Buick Regal T-Type is one of a reported 1,921 examples that were produced for the model year and it is powered by a turbocharged 3.8-liter V6 linked with a Stage 2 four-speed automatic transmission and a limited-slip differential. Now showing 62k miles, the car is finished in Cream Beige over Tan leather and vinyl upholstery.

title: 2006 Porsche Cayenne S Titanium Edition
highlights: This 2006 Porsche Cayenne S is a Titanium Edition example finished in Black, and edition-specific features include Titanium Metallic exterior trim, xenon headlights, 19″ Cayenne Design wheels, two-tone leather upholstery, and branded door sill guards.

title: 2023 Audi S5 Cabriolet Premium Plus
highlights: THIS... is a 2023 Audi S5 Cabriolet Premium Plus, finished in Mythos Black Metallic with a black soft top and a Magma Red interior, and offered by Carbine123, a Cars & Bids Certified Seller. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Audi’s past. It also shows that this S5 has been registered in Louisiana since new.

title: 2005 Toyota Tundra Limited Double Cab V8 4×4
highlights: This 2005 Toyota Tundra Limited Double Cab pickup was sold new in New York and has been registered in Texas since 2009. It now has 111k miles and is powered by a 4.7-liter V8 that drives the rear or all four wheels through a five-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a limited-slip differential.

title: 1975 Honda CB400F Super Sport
highlights: This 1975 Honda CB400F Super Sport underwent work in 2022 that included rebuilding the Keihin carburetors and front brake caliper as well as adjusting the valves, resealing the fork, reupholstering the black vinyl two-up seat, upgrading the front primary brake cylinder, installing an electronic ignition system, and replacing the intake boots, front brake pads, tires, battery, spark plugs, and drive chain.

title: 6.6L-Powered 1981 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am 4-Speed Conversion
highlights: This 1981 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am was acquired by the seller in 2010 and subsequently fitted with a 6.6-liter V8 and a four-speed manual transmission. Work performed since 2024 has involved installing a 3″ exhaust system and a CVF Racing serpentine belt kit as well as replacing the water pump, radiator, carburetor, and components for the power steering and braking systems.

title: 1988 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ62 High Roof 5-Speed
highlights: This 1988 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ62 high roof is a left-hand-drive example that spent time in Colombia before being brought to the US in 2022. It was later offered on BaT in March 2023 and was acquired in 2026 by the seller, who subsequently installed 16″ wheels wrapped in BFGoodrich tires.

title: 2006 Subaru Baja Turbo
highlights: THIS... is a 2006 Subaru Baja Turbo, finished in Brilliant Silver Metallic with a gray interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report indicates no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Baja’s past. It also shows Southern ownership since new. A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes 16-inch wheels, a limited-slip rear differential, a Switchback cargo system, leather upholstery, and heated front seats.

title: 2020 Porsche Taycan 4S
highlights: THIS... is a 2020 Porsche Taycan 4S, finished in white with a Bordeaux Red interior. The odometer on this Taycan currently displays approximately 19,200 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report indicates no mileage discrepancies in this Porsche’s past; it also shows California and Washington ownership since new.

title: 1998 Chevrolet Suburban K1500 LT 4×4
highlights: This 1998 Chevrolet K1500 Suburban LT remained registered to the original owner and their spouse in Hawaii and California through 2026 and now shows 87k miles. It is finished in Olympic White and Light Autumnwood Metallic over Neutral leather and powered by a 5.7-liter V8 linked to a four-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a locking rear differential.

title: 38k-MIle 2010 Audi Q5 3.2 Quattro Prestige
highlights: This 2010 Audi Q5 Prestige has remained registered in Florida from new and now has 38k miles. The truck is powered by a 3.2-liter V6 linked with a six-speed automatic transaxle and a Quattro all-wheel-drive system, and it is finished in Ibis White over Pistachio Beige leather upholstery.

title: 8k-Mile 2002 Dodge Viper RT/10
highlights: This 2002 Dodge Viper RT/10 has 8k miles, and it remained in the original owner’s care until earlier this year. It is finished in Viper Red over black leather and is powered by an 8.0-liter V10 paired with a six-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes a limited-slip differential, a removable hardtop, 18″ five-spoke alloy wheels, power windows, a CD stereo, and air conditioning.

title: 2015 Land Rover LR4 HSE
highlights: This 2015 Land Rover LR4 HSE has been in Texas and California with two owners since new, and it is powered by a supercharged 3.0-liter V6 linked to an eight-speed automatic transmission.

title: 2016 BMW M5
highlights: THIS... is a 2016 BMW M5, finished in Black Sapphire Metallic with a Silverstone interior, and offered by Nexusautobrokers, a Cars & Bids Certified Seller. This M5 is equipped with the desirable 6-speed manual transmission. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this M5's past.

Features include both kick and electric starters, dual Keihin carburetors, 18″ wire-spoke wheels, and center and side stands, as well as a chrome dual exhaust system, a black vinyl-upholstered two-up seat, and street lighting. The bike was acquired by the selling dealer in 2026.

title: 15k-Mile 1998 Ferrari F355 Spider 6-Speed
highlights: This 1998 Ferrari F355 Spider is finished in Giallo Modena over black Connolly leather and is powered by a 3.5-liter DOHC V8 linked to a six-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. It rolls on 18″ five-spoke magnesium wheels and is further equipped with a black soft top, pop-up headlights, a gated shifter, automatic climate control, and an Alpine head unit and amplifier.

title: 35k-Mile 2007 Saturn Sky
highlights: This 2007 Saturn Sky has 35k miles and has been registered in Florida from new. The car is finished in green with decals over black and tan leather, and it is powered by a 2.4-liter Ecotec inline-four linked to a five-speed automatic transmission.

title: Fuel-Injected, 331-Powered 1966 Ford Mustang Fastback 5-Speed
highlights: This 1966 Ford Mustang fastback was refurbished and modified by Barry’s Speed shop, Corona, California, before it was exported to the UK and purchased by the selling dealer in 2023. The car is finished in Wimbledon White with painted blue stripes, and it is powered by a 331ci stroker V8 with Trick Flow aluminum intake manifold and heads as well as Borla eight-stack fuel injection.

title: 1992 Isuzu Pickup S 5-Speed
highlights: This 1991 Isuzu Pickup S is said to have been registered to two owners in Nevada since the time it was new until the selling dealer’s June 2026 acquisition, and its odometer now shows 42k miles. Finished in Iron Gray Metallic over gray cloth upholstery, the truck is powered by a 2.3-liter SOHC inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission.

title: 1968 Chevrolet Camaro RS Coupe
highlights: THIS... is a 1968 Chevrolet Camaro RS Coupe, finished in Butternut Yellow with a black interior. A partial list of notable currently installed equipment reported by the seller includes 15-inch Rally wheels, power steering, power brakes, a vinyl roof, vinyl upholstery, and a fold-down rear seat. The first-generation Camaro made its debut in late 1966 to compete head-to-head against the Ford Mustang.

title: 2017 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT
highlights: THIS… is a 2017 Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT, finished in Diamond Black Crystal Pearl Coat with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this SRT’s past. According to the digital window sticker provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Customer Preferred Package 27L, 20-inch wheels, a dual-pane panoramic sunroof, a suede-like headliner, and a Harman/Kardon sound system.

title: One-Owner 2000 Ford Excursion Limited Power Stroke 4×4
highlights: This 2000 Ford Excursion Limited 4×4 has remained registered to one owner in Nebraska since new and now shows 72k miles. It is finished in Oxford White over Medium Parchment leather and powered by a 7.3-liter Power Stroke turbodiesel V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission, a dual-range transfer case, and a limited-slip rear differential.

title: 39k-Mile 2004 Lexus ES330
highlights: This 2004 Lexus ES330 remained registered in Florida until the selling dealer’s 2026 acquisition, and it has 39k miles. Finished in Starlight Pearl over tan leather, the car is powered by a 3.3-liter V6 paired with a five-speed automatic transaxle.

title: 2012 Land Rover Range Rover Sport Supercharged
highlights: This 2012 Land Rover Range Rover Sport Supercharged has 56k miles and is finished in Indus Silver over Ebony leather with Ivory stitching. Power is from a supercharged 5.0-liter V8 linked to a six-speed automatic transmission, a full-time four-wheel-drive system, and a dual-range transfer case.

title: 1986 Ford F-250 XLT Lariat
highlights: THIS… is a 1986 Ford F-250 XLT Lariat, finished in orange with a Chestnut interior. This F-250 features the desirable 4-speed manual transmission. The attached Carfax history report contains multiple reporting gaps, though it shows no accidents during the given time period.

title: 2023 Mazda MX-5 Miata Club
highlights: THIS... is a 2023 Mazda MX-5 Miata Club, finished in Snowflake White Pearl with a black soft top and a black interior. This Miata features the desirable 6-speed manual transmission. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents in this Mazda's past.

title: 502-Powered, Custom-Built 1937 Oldsmobile Victoria Rosé Street Rod
highlights: This 1937 Oldsmobile began life as an L37 four-door touring sedan, and it underwent a multi-year build begun by Andy Leach of CAL Auto Creations and completed by Roger Burman of Lakeside Rods and Rides in 2004. Dubbed ‘Victoria Rosé,’ it was subsequently featured in articles in Street Rod and Street Rodder, and was featured on the cover of the August/September 2004 issue of Northern Rodder.

title: 18k-Mile 2009 Audi R8 Coupe 6-Speed
highlights: This 2009 Audi R8 coupe was purchased by the current owner in 2010, and they have since added approximately 11k of the 18k indicated miles. Finished in Ibis White over Limestone Gray leather and Alcantara, the car is powered by a 4.2-liter FSI V8 that drives all four wheels through a six-speed manual transaxle. Equipment includes Ice Silver side blades, a Bang & Olufsen sound system, 19″ double-spoke wheels, and heated power-adjustable seats.

title: 1997 Nissan Hardbody XE King Cab 4×4 5-Speed
interior_color: gray cloth upholstery w/beige vinyle sides
highlights: This 1997 Nissan Hardbody XE is a King Cab 4×4 pickup that has remained registered in Nevada and Arkansas since new and was purchased in 2024 by the selelr, who subsequently replaced the timing chain and various components for its 2.4-liter KA24 inline-four. Finished in Platinum Gold over gray cloth upholstery, the car is equipped with a five-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case.

title: RB25DET NEO–Powered 1999 Nissan Skyline GT Coupe 5-Speed
highlights: This 1999 Nissan Skyline GT coupe was fitted with GT-R–style bodywork, repainted in Midnight Purple, and upgraded with a turbocharged 2.5-liter RB25DET NEO and a five-speed manual transmission in Japan before being brought to the US in 2026. The car wears 19″ WORK Schwert SC4 wheels and also has xenon headlamps as well as an APEXi cat-back exhaust system.

title: 158-Mile 2002 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am WS6 Coupe 6-Speed
highlights: This 2002 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am coupe was initially delivered to Grau Pontiac of Lincoln, Illinois, and is said to have remained in a climate-controlled collection from new. The car now has 158 miles and is powered by a 5.7-liter LS1 V8 linked to a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential.

title: 1994 Land Rover Defender 90 NAS 5-Speed
highlights: This 1994 Land Rover Defender 90 is one of approximately 2,000 North American-specification examples imported into the US for the model year. It is finished in AA Yellow over gray upholstery and is powered by a 3.9-liter V8 linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case.

title: 20k-Mile, Original-Owner 1995 Mazda MX-5 Miata 5-Speed
highlights: This 1995 Mazda MX-5 Miata was leased new and later purchased by the seller, and it shows 20k miles.

title: 2002 Chevrolet Camaro Z28 SS Coupe

This Camaro is equipped with the desirable 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 860 miles. The attached Carfax vehicle history report contains multiple reporting gaps, though it shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies during the given time period.

title: 1964 Pontiac Bonneville Superior High-Top Ambulance
highlights: THIS... is a 1964 Pontiac Bonneville Superior High-Top Ambulance, finished in red with a red and white interior. A partial list of notable currently installed equipment reported by the selling dealer includes a Superior Coach high-top ambulance conversion, a rear air suspension system, emergency lighting, vinyl upholstery, a custom partition, stretcher provisions, window curtains, and storage cabinets.

title: 2018 Audi Q7 3.0T Prestige
highlights: This 2018 Audi Q7 3.0T Prestige was ordered with the Cold Weather and Driver Assistance packages as well as adaptive cruise control, a panoramic sunroof, a head-up display, 21″ split-spoke wheels, heated and ventilated front seats, and a top-view camera system with Virtual 360 view.

title: 2014 BMW 335i Sedan
highlights: THIS… is a 2014 BMW 335i Sedan, finished in Estoril Blue Metallic with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no mileage discrepancies in this BMW’s past. It also shows that this 335i has been registered in California, Oklahoma, and Texas since new.

title: 340 Six Pack–Powered 1972 Plymouth ’Cuda
highlights: This 1972 Plymouth ’Cuda coupe is said to have been refurbished around 2004 and is powered by a replacement 340ci V8 featuring a Six Pack–style induction system.

title: 48k-Mile 2004 Toyota Sequoia SR5
highlights: This 2004 Toyota Sequoia SR5 remained registered in California until the seller’s acquisition in 2026, and it now has 48k miles. Finished in Desert Sand Mica over Oak cloth, it is powered by a 4.7-liter V8 linked with a four-speed automatic transmission.

title: 2011 Land Rover Range Rover HSE
highlights: This 2011 Land Rover Range Rover HSE is finished in Fuji White over Ebony leather and powered by a 5.0-liter AJ133 V8 that drives all four wheels through a six-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case with an electronic center differential.

title: 2022 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 6-Speed
highlights: This 2022 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 was acquired new by the seller from Porsche Jacksonville in Florida, and it now has 2,200 miles. The car is powered by a 4.0-liter flat-six linked to a six-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential with Porsche Torque Vectoring and rolls on Satin Black 20″ Cayman GT4 alloy wheels.

title: 22-Years-Owned 1964 Volkswagen Type 2 Bus
highlights: This 1964 Volkswagen Type 2 is an 11-window bus that was delivered new to Los Angeles. It was refinished in blue and white before it was acquired by the seller in 2004, and its single-port 1600cc flat-four was overhauled in 2006. Its beige interior features two-tone upholstery, a wraparound rear bench, Pioneer speakers, and pop-out windows. Other details include safari windows, 15″ steel wheels, and a 12-volt electrical system.

title: 1988 BMW M5
highlights: This 1988 BMW M5 is one of 1,340 examples produced for the North American market, and it was initially delivered to Athens BMW in Athens, Georgia, and remained registered in Florida until 2026. It is powered by a 3.5-liter inline-six paired with a five-speed manual transmission and is finished in black over Natur leather.

title: 14k-Mile 2001 Dodge Viper GTS
highlights: This 2001 Dodge Viper GTS is finished in Deep Sapphire Blue over Cognac Connolly leather, and it shows 14k miles. It has spent most of its time registered in California and Montana and was purchased by the seller in December 2021.

title: 2003 Ferrari 360 Spider
highlights: THIS... is a 2003 Ferrari 360 Spider, finished in Argento Nurburgring with a black soft top and a Nero interior. This Ferrari is a US-spec 360 Spider that's registered and located in British Columbia, Canada. Reportedly imported to Canada in 2007, the odometer reads in imperial units and indicates approximately 27,800 miles.

title: 44k-Mile 2016 Mazda MX-5 Miata Club 6-Speed
highlights: This 2016 Mazda MX-5 Miata Club was specified from the factory with the Brembo/BBS and Appearance Packages before being delivered new to Lou Fusz Mazda of St. Louis, Missouri. Finished in Meteor Gray Mica over black cloth upholstery, the car is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four linked with a six-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential.

title: 1997 Saab 900 SE Turbo Convertible 5-Speed

It is finished in Scarabe Green Metallic over Sand Beige leather, and equipment includes a black convertible top, 16″ three-spoke alloy wheels, a power-adjustable driver’s seat, a Pioneer CD stereo, and automatic climate control.
